contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Tuesday, January 13: A Corsican separatist leader is gunned down while attending his mother's funeral. Also, a famous Italian anti-mafia writer pens an opinion piece, questioning the Corsican crime ties of Jacques Moretti, co-owner of the bar in Crans-Montana where a fire killed dozens of people on New Year's Eve. The Daily Telegraph reveals that China's new embassy in London will include a secret underground network. Plus: how AI is complicating efforts to find a gang of monkeys on the loose in the US!
